What are the last four digits of the phone number we have on file for you?

hints.day_month_swapped: Could you please say your date of birth again, with the month as a word?

lines.opening: Hello, this is the digital assistant calling from Freya Bank. We record this call.
lines.robot: I am Freya Bank's digital assistant.
lines.scam: You can verify this call by phoning Freya Bank's customer service number.
lines.purpose_before_verify: I can explain once I have confirmed I am speaking with the right person.
lines.no_info: I'm sorry, I do not have that information.
lines.not_talk_once: I understand. This will only take a moment.
lines.tp_ask_time: What day and time would suit? I can call back today or the next business day, between 10 AM and 7 PM.
lines.tp_outside_window: I'm sorry, I can only call back today or the next business day, between 10 AM and 7 PM. Is there another time that works?
lines.tp_no_info: I'm sorry, I can only speak about this with {title} {last_name}.
lines.tp_booked: Thank you. We will call back on {date} at {time}.
lines.condolence: I am sorry for your loss.
lines.id_intro: Before we continue, I need to ask you two security questions.
lines.id_explain: I ask these questions to protect your account. I can only continue once you answer them.
lines.id_declined: I understand. Without these answers I cannot continue.
lines.id_repeat: Sorry, I did not catch that. Could you repeat it, please?
lines.id_wrong: That does not match our records. Could you try again, please?
lines.id_failed: I'm sorry, I cannot verify your identity. Please use the Freya Bank mobile app or visit a branch.
lines.disclose_intro: Thank you. I am calling from the Freya Bank collections team about a late payment.
lines.product_line: Your {name} has {amount} past due and is {days} days late.
lines.ask_today: Can you make this payment today?
lines.ask_today_multi: Can you make these payments today?
lines.offer_floor_date: I understand. Could you pay {amount} on {date}? The rest stays overdue.
lines.offer_floor: I understand. Could you pay {amount}? The rest stays overdue.
lines.below_floor: I'm sorry, I cannot record that amount. The lowest amount I can accept is {amount}. Could you pay that?
lines.below_floor_again: I'm sorry, that amount is below {amount}, so I cannot accept it.
lines.date_past: That date has already passed. Could you choose today or a later date?
lines.not_business_day: That day is not a business day. The next business day is {date}. Would that work?
lines.after_deadline: The latest date I can accept is {date}. Could you pay on {date}?
lines.vague_ask: Which exact day would that be?
lines.ask_date_for_amount: On which day could you pay {amount}?
lines.repeat_offer: Just to repeat, could you pay {amount} on {date}?
lines.clamped_note: For your {name}, the latest date I can accept is {date}.
lines.recorded: Thank you, your promise is recorded.
lines.sms_line: You will receive a text message confirming this promise.
lines.record_failed: I'm sorry, I could not record your promise.
lines.paid_line: Thank you. Payments can take one business day to appear.
lines.dispute_line: I understand. I will not take a promise today.
lines.hardship: I'm very sorry to hear that. Would you like me to connect you with our customer support team?
lines.hardship_offer_again: Would you like me to connect you with our customer support team? Please say yes or no.
lines.restructure_line: I will connect you with a colleague who can help with that.
lines.human_ask_help: Before I transfer you, is there anything I can help you with?
lines.transfer: I am connecting you now. Please hold.
lines.anything_else: Is there anything else I can help you with?
lines.promise_change: You can change it in the mobile app.
lines.goodbye: Thank you for your time. Goodbye.

assumptions: The brief names no currency. currency_word is set to the default 'dollars'.
Rule 1 requires saying the call is recorded. The opening uses 'We record this call.' in active voice.
Rule 6 allows 'today or the next business day' and does not require today to be a business day, so business_days_only stays false.
Callback max_asks = 2: one ask, then one more ask after a time outside the window (rule 7).
Confirmation max_asks = 2 (rule 3: ask once more, then close as unclear).
Rule 22: 'next <weekday>' means the following calendar week (following_week).
A numeric-only date of birth is read as day, month, year (dmy), per rule 11.
Identity: 3 wrong answers in total end the check (rule 12). A day_month_swapped hint retry is not counted as wrong (rule 13).
Hint day_month_swapped (rule 13: 'Ask them to say the month as a word'): the agent asks for the whole date of birth again with the month as a word, so the verify tool gets a complete date to check.
Rule 15: asking what the call is about counts as declining (purpose_is_decline=true). Other customer questions (robot, scam) are answered and do not count as declining (question_is_decline=false).
Floor names: 'minimum payment' for credit cards and 'instalment amount' for loans, from rule 25 field names minimum_payment / instalment_amount.
Bands come from rule 18: early is 1-7 days with a deadline on the 12th business day and 1 attempt; late is 8-45 days with a deadline on the 7th business day and 2 attempts.

Ladder: attempt 1 is the full amount, or the floor if the customer already said the full amount is too much, on the last business day of this week. If today is that day, it moves to the last business day of next week (engine fallback, rule 30). Attempt 2 (late band only) is the floor on the deadline.
Deadlines are counted in business days, so they always fall on a business day. deadline_adjust is set to the default previous_business_day.
Refusing the deadline or the floor counts as a flat refusal (rules 23, 26, 27).
The brief does not say whether to ask 'anything else' after a recorded promise. The default true is used.
Brief A never uses add_note, so notes.enabled=false. Note values in events are taken from the add_note reason enum for completeness only.
Brief A covers one product. The multi settings keep their defaults.
Human request: ask once whether the agent can help first, then transfer to queue 'general' with reason 'human' (rule 42).
Hardship transfer uses queue 'support' and closes as transferred/support. If declined, it closes as no_promise/hardship (rule 32).
Restructuring uses queue 'restructuring' and closes as transferred/restructuring (rule 41).
Saying 'I don't want to talk' twice closes the call: no_promise/refused after verification, not_verified/declined before it (rule 45). max_not_talk=2.
promise_change uses the rule 36 wording: change it in the mobile app.
sms_line uses the exact sentence from rule 38. confirm_q is 'Do you confirm?' (rule 34). ask_today is 'Can you make this payment today?' (rule 28). condolence is 'I am sorry for your loss.' (rule 9).
If a transfer follows a recorded promise, the call closes as transferred with that transfer's reason (rule 46).
